## Fix acceptance and follow-up

<!-- State the bounded correction, owner or related work when known, and required validation. -->

An authorized contributor may implement the correction. Independent approval must come from someone who did not
author that change. Preserve the original fixed-SHA finding; use explicit follow-up conclusions for new evidence.
